title: Frozen. Olaf the snowman.
lines: High in the mountains of Arendelle, where the snow is as white as sugar, lives a queen with a very special magic power.
Her name is Elsa.
When Elsa waves her hands, snowflakes swirl through the air.
Swoosh!
And when she taps her foot on the ground, tap, the floor turns into smooth, shiny ice.
Elsa has a little sister.
Her name is Anna.
Anna is cheerful and brave and she loves to laugh.
But one day Elsa became afraid of her own magic.
She ran away, high into the mountains, and there she built a beautiful ice palace.
The palace sparkled in the sun like a big diamond.
Wow, it was so beautiful!
But Elsa was also a little lonely, all alone in that big palace.
So what did she do?
She made a snowman!
She rolled a big snowball for the tummy, a middle-sized one for the body, and a small one for the head.
She put two sticks in his sides for arms.
And for a nose?
For a nose he got a long, orange carrot!
And then something magical happened.
Ping!
The snowman blinked his eyes and started to talk.
Hello!
I'm Olaf, and I like warm hugs!
Hee hee hee!
Olaf was the funniest snowman in the whole world.
He danced, he sang, and sometimes his head fell off his body by accident.
Plop!
Oops!
Then he just put it back on.
Peekaboo!
Meanwhile Anna went looking for her sister Elsa.
But the mountains were high and the snow was deep.
Luckily she met a strong young man.
His name was Kristoff.
And Kristoff had a very good friend who always helped him: a reindeer!
The reindeer's name was Sven.
Sven had big antlers on his head and a warm brown coat.
He pulled the sled through the snow.
Hop, hop, hop!
And when Kristoff took a carrot out of his pocket, they shared it: one for you, and one for me.
Nibble, nibble!
On the way they found Olaf.
Oh, Sven got such a fright!
He licked Olaf's carrot nose.
Slurp!
Hee hee, that tickles, laughed Olaf.
Then Olaf told them his big secret.
Do you know what I dream about?
he said.
I dream about summer!
About the warm sun on my tummy!
About sandcastles and ice creams and lying in the grass!
Kristoff gave him a funny look.
But Olaf, he said, you're a snowman.
When summer comes, you'll melt!
But Olaf didn't mind.
He sang happily about the sun and summer, and he pretended to lie on the beach.
Lovely, said Olaf.
Together they went on through the snow.
Sven the reindeer pulled the sled, Kristoff held the reins, Anna looked out for the ice palace, and Olaf sang.
Whoosh!
They slid down a hill over the slippery ice.
Wheee!
At last they found Elsa.
But Elsa was still afraid.
She thought she would hurt everyone with her ice.
It got cold everywhere, colder, the coldest ever.
Brrr!
Anna went completely stiff from the cold.
Oh dear, oh dear!
But then Anna did something very loving.
She protected her sister Elsa.
And Elsa gave her little sister a big hug and cried with love.
And look, that true love melted all the ice!
Drip, drip, drip!
The sun came back and the flowers opened.
And Olaf?
Elsa waved her hands and made a little snow cloud above his head.
So Olaf could finally enjoy summer, the warm sun, without melting!
I'm so happy, shouted Olaf.
And Kristoff?
He got a brand-new sled.
And his loyal reindeer Sven got a whole bag full of carrots.
Nibble, nibble!
Everyone was happy, and they lived happily ever after.
